This page explains what these technologies are and how we use them. A cookie is a small file containing letters and numbers placed on your computer or smartphone that is transferred to your hard drive. Like most commercial websites, our website uses cookies to distinguish you from other users of our websites and recognize repeat users. This helps us to provide you with a better experience when you browse our website and allows us to improve our site and services. Pixels are small pieces of code on webpages that do things like allow another server to measure viewing of a webpage and often are used in connection with cookies. By continuing to browse Segmanta’s websites, you are consenting to our use of cookies and pixels as described on this page and in our Privacy Policy . We use the following cookies and pixels: Strictly necessary cookies. These are cookies so that our website operates correctly. They include, for example, cookies that enable you to log into secure areas of our services, authenticate your user login, or make use of our subscription services. Analytics cookies (for example, Google Analytics or Mixpanel). These cookies allow us to recognize and count the number of visitors and to see how visitors interact with our website on an aggregate level. They also allow us to measure the success of our advertising campaign and detect if visitors are having any difficulties with our websites. This helps us improve the way our website works, for example, by ensuring that users are finding what they are looking for easily. Functionality cookies. These cookies are used to recognize you when you return to our website. This enables us to personalize our content for you and remember your preferences (for example, your choice of language). We also use these cookies to prevent users from taking surveys multiple times, or the frequency as defined by the Survey Creator. Targeting and advertising cookies (for example, Google AdWords or Facebook Marketing Pixels). These cookies record your visit to our website, the pages you have visited and the links you have followed.
